description: This file defines a template class WebSocketClientImpl that manages WebSocket client connections, message handling, and connection status updates, specifically for media and DRM services within a backend API.

classes.name: WebSocketClientImpl
classes.description: A template class implementing a WebSocket client for media streaming, handling connection, disconnection, message reception, and connection status updates.

methods.name: WebSocketClientImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the WebSocket client with an AudioPlayer instance and setting up message handling.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to the specified URI after processing it to ensure proper format and port.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming WebSocket messages by passing data to the AudioPlayer.

methods.name: onServiceConnection
methods.description: Handles the result of a WebSocket connection attempt, updating connection status and notifying the AudioPlayer.

methods.name: onServiceDisconnected
methods.description: Handles WebSocket disconnection events, updating status and notifying the AudioPlayer.

methods.name: removeProtocol
methods.description: Removes the protocol part ('://') from a URI string.

methods.name: ensureAddressHasPortNumber
methods.description: Ensures the address string includes a port number, appending default if missing.
